writeup: The Chuckit! Amphibious Bumper in Medium (model 18300) is a floating fetch toy built for water-loving dogs, and Woot has it new for $6.99. State Line Pet Supply charges $13.80, Petmate's own Chuckit! store $15.99 and Klem's $17.99 for the same toy, so this is about 49% below the cheapest store. Woot showed only 1 left with a limit of 6 per customer.
